drag_coefficient_sphere — DRIVE ball op

• Data kinds: signal → signal

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.drag_coefficient_sphere(reynolds) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import ballistics; ballistics.drag_coefficient_sphere(reynolds) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("drag_coefficient_sphere"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

滑らかな球の抗力係数の経験式(Morrison 2013、Re ≲ 1e6): 24/Re + 2.6(Re/5)/(1 + (Re/5)^1.52) + 0.411(Re/263000)^−7.94/(1 + (Re/263000)^−8)

+ 0.25(Re/1e6)/(1 + Re/1e6)。卓球の球(Re ≈ 1〜5 × 10⁴)で ≈ 0.4〜0.5。
